scope: Week 2 draft: every footprint with a specific use label (not bare D/S/F), plus fuel, oil and boiler/engine rooms. Plain dwellings, stores and unlabeled sheds are not listed. Groups of identical footprints (e.g. a row of KILNs) are one entry with the count in notes.

buildings.label: ST. AMBROSIUS ITALIAN R.C. CHURCH
buildings.notes: 20' to eaves, tower 60'. Heat: stoves, lights: lamps. Today's St. Ambrose (rebuilt 1926) is at Wilson & Marconi; Cooper Ave may be Marconi's old name, verify

notes: Mostly empty lots in 1903 (blocks 4083, 4073 nearly vacant). A row of 10 brick dwellings at 2222-2240 Edwards (bottom right) is not listed (plain D). The church is the early St. Ambrose, the center of the Italian Hill.
